name: io.github.Servosity/nerdio-mcp
title: Nerdio Manager MCP
description: The first non-PowerShell client for the Nerdio Manager for MSP API - cross-account AVD fleet

environmentVariables.name: NERDIO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Set the NERDIO_BASE_URL credential for the Nerdio Manager MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: NERDIO_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Set the NERDIO_TOKEN_URL credential for the Nerdio Manager MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: NERDIO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the NERDIO_CLIENT_ID credential for the Nerdio Manager MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: NERDIO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set the NERDIO_CLIENT_SECRET credential for the Nerdio Manager MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: NERDIO_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Set the NERDIO_OAUTH_SCOPE credential for the Nerdio Manager MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: NERDIO_NO_CONFIG_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

environmentVariables.name: NERDIO_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

environmentVariables.name: NERDIO_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: NERDIO_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: NERDIO_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Nerdio Manager requests.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.
